out_items.name: Food in good condition, safe, and unadulterated

violations.title: Safe, Unadulterated & Honestly Presented
violations.observation: The following food item(s) is observed to be unsound or adulterated: 1) mold was observed growing in an open container of mascarpone cheese
violations.corrective_action: ALL food shall be safe, unadulterated and honestly presented as specified under 3-601.12. STAFF DISCARDED THE CHEESE. KALYPSO'S SPORT TAVERN (Inspection Date: 07/08/2026) Page 2 of 3

out_items.name: Required records available: shellstock tags, parasite destruction

violations.title: Shellstock Removed from Tagged or Labeled Container
violations.observation: A bus boy container of oysters was observed being stored in the walk-in without a shellstock tag
violations.corrective_action: Shellstock that has been removed from the tagged/labeled container must have a system used to identify source. PIC DISCARDED THE OYSTERS. EHS PROVIDED SHELLSTOCK GUIDANCE.

out_items.name: Food separated and protected

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: 1) in the walk-in cooler: Raw beef was observed being stored over ricotta; Raw beef was observed being stored over cooked chicken 2) in the 2DR glass slide: Raw fish was observed being stored on top of cream cheese
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. EHS PROVIDED GUIDANCE TO PREVENT CROSS CONTAMINATION. PIC AND STAFF STARTED TO REARRANGE ALL OF THE FOOD IN THE WALK-IN. EHS WILL FOLLOW UP FOR COMPLIANCE.

out_items.name: Proper cold holding temperatures

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: 1) in the 4DWR prep top cooler, cook line: coleslaw (53f), sliced cheese (44f) 2) in the 2DR lowboy cooler, expo: tzatziki (49f) 3) in the 2DR glass slide cooler: unsalted butter (44f), canned crab (45f), blue cheese crumbles (46f)
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. PIC AND STAFF DISCARDED THE AFOREMENTIONED FOODS.

out_items.name: Proper date marking and disposition

violations.title: RTE TCS Food, Disposition
violations.observation: Observed the following ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food being held for more than the specified time/temperature allowed: 1) Greek chicken 2) spinach dip
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be discarded if it: 1) exceeds 7 days or at 41F (except the time it is frozen); or 2) is in a container or package that does not bear a date or day. STAFF DISCARDED THE AFOREMENTIONED FOODS.

out_items.name: Insects, rodents, and animals not present

violations.title: Controlling Pests, Pest Control Methods
violations.observation: Observed mouse droppings on sheet trays and cutting boards in storage. Observed the rear kitchen door open. A temporary screen door was observed being used at the rear kitchen doorway. Screen door was observed ineffectively being used allowing large gaps above and below the door.
violations.corrective_action: Insects and other pests are capable of transmitting disease to people by contaminating food and food-contact surfaces. If pests are found on the premises methods shall be used to control their presence. PIC INSTRUCTED STAFF TO WASH, RINSHE, AND SANITIZE THE SHEET TRAYS AND CUTTING BOARDS. PIC CLOSED THE DOOR.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Poison/Toxic Material, Conditions of Use
violations.observation: Observed a can of Raid being stored under the dish machine.
violations.corrective_action: Remove residential use pesticides from the facility. When necessary for pest control, chemical pesticides must be applied by a certified pesticide applicator to prevent injury and contamination. PIC DISCARDED THE PESTICIDE. HOME-USE PESTICIDES ARE NOT ALLOW TO BE APPLIED IN COMMERCIAL FOOD ESTABLISHMENTS. CONSULT WITH YOUR LICENSED PEST CONTROL OPERATOR FOR ADDITIONAL SERVICES.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Observed food being stored on the floor of the walk-in cooler
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. ELEVATE ALL FOOD TO FACILITATE PROPER CLEANING.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: 1) 4DWR prep top cooler across from the cook line was observed at 44f; 2) 2DR low boy cooler by the expo station was observed at 52f; 3) 2DR low boy cooler by the dish machine was observed at 49f
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. DO NOT USE THESE COOLERS UNTIL THEY CAN MAINTAIN PROPER COLD HOLDING TEMPERATURES. CONTACT THE SERVICE TECHNICIAN TO REPAIR. COOLERS WORK BEST WHEN SET TO 32-38f. THIS IS A REPEAT VIOLATION. KALYPSO'S SPORT TAVERN (Inspection Date: 01/14/2026) Page 2 of 3

violations.corrective_action: Non-food contact surfaces of equipment that are exposed to splash, spillage, or other foods that require frequent cleaning shall be constructed of a corrosion- resistant, nonabsorbent, and smooth material. REMOVE FOIL TO AVOID HARBORAGE CONDITIONS.

out_items.name: Required records available: shellstock tags, parasite destruction

violations.title: Shellstock Label Marked, Last Date Served/Sold Info
violations.observation: On the available shellstock tags for oysters, the date in which the last piece of shellstock was sold or discarded was not recorded on the tag.
violations.corrective_action: The identity of the source of shellstock (oysters, clams, mussels) that are sold or served shall be maintained by retaining shellstock tags or labels and marking the tag or label with the date when the last shellstock from the container is sold or served. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO WRITE THE DATE WHEN THE LAST PIECE OF SHELLSTOCK WAS SOLD OR DISCARDED. RETAIN ALL SHELLSTOCK TAGS FOR 90 DAYS IN CHRONOLOGICAL ORDER.

out_items.name: Food-contact surfaces cleaned and sanitized

violations.title: Chemical Sanitization, Chlorine Requirements
violations.observation: When tested, the two chlorine dish machines at the large bar and the small bar were observed with a sanitizing rinse concentration of less than 50 ppm chlorine solution.
violations.corrective_action: Immediately discontinue use of the dishmachine. Until the machine is adequately repaired, set up the three-compartment sink to manually wash, rinse and sanitize food-contact surfaces using a sanitizing solution at the proper concentration of at least 50 to 200 ppm total chlorine. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO DISCONTINUE THE USE OF THE MACHINES UNTIL THEY ARE REPAIRED AND CAN SANITIZE AT THE APPROPRIATE CONCENTRATION. PIC CALLED HIS SERVICE TECHNICIAN TO REPAIR THE MACHINE.

violations.title: Food Contact Surface, Clean after Use
violations.observation: Observed the meat slicer with food debris on the cutting surface. Upon discussion with PIC, meat slicer has not been used for several days.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment food-contact surfaces and utensils shall be cleaned at any time during the operation when contamination may have occurred. PIC INSTRUCTED STAFF TO START CLEANING THE MEAT SLICER.

out_items.name: Time as a Public Health Control; procedures and records

violations.title: TPHC, Food Marked with 4 Hour End Point
violations.observation: EHS observed breading station for chicken wings and calamari being held using Time as a Public Health Control without being marked with a 4 hour endpoint.
violations.corrective_action: If time only, rather than time in accordance with temperature control, up to a maximum of 4 hours, is used as the public health control the food shall: 1) have an initial temperature of 41F or less if removed from cold holding temperature OR 135F or above if removed from hot holding temperature control, 2) be marked or otherwise identified to indicate the time that is 4 hours past the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control, 3) be cooked and served, served if ready-to- eat, or discarded within 4 hours from the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control, and 4) be discarded if unmarked or marked to exceed a 4 hour limit. PIC marked breading station with a 4 hour endpoint.
